name: GlobalOpinionQA
description: GlobalOpinionQA is a dataset of questions and answers from cross-national surveys capturing diverse global opinions on societal issues. It enables evaluation of language models' representation of subjective global perspectives by comparing model-generated responses to human survey data conditioned on country.
reputation: A newer benchmark that has gained attention for evaluating whether models reflect country-conditioned global opinions, but it is not yet a broadly established standard.
notes: Highlights biases in LLMs towards certain populations; includes multilingual evaluation and interactive visualization.
